g.title: Neural
g.text: Inside SoulX LITE | One generated video chunk
Example: 320 × 576 native output · shared learned weights, private session history

g.title: image
g.text: Resize / crop to native frame geometry

g.title: concat
g.text: Concatenate noise and reference along channels

g.title: wav
g.text: Extract speech features; does not synthesize voice

g.title: proj
g.text: Learned weights belong to Model_Lite checkpoint

g.title: state
g.text: Motion prefix: initially 1 latent frame, then 2
State changes during inference; weights do not

g.title: noise
g.text: Clamp motion prefix at each sampling step

g.title: blocks
g.text: Same stack reused at every denoising step

g.title: sample
g.text: Estimate clean latent and add scheduled noise
Four passes in the usual distilled profile
More steps = more computation, not more learned weights

g.title: decode
g.text: VAE has its own checkpoint (~419.2M stored values)

g.title: feedback
g.text: Last 9 corrected native frames → VAE ENCODER
Update motion latents for the next chunk

g.title: useful
g.text: 0.96 s at 25 FPS; 1.60 s at 15 FPS

g.title: enhance
g.text: Optional display enhancement after native history
Existing SR experiments / proposed mouth refiner
Distinct weights; not another DiT sampling step

g.title: encode
g.text: Mux or play original speech separately

g.title: note
g.text: Checkpoint includes audio adapter and unused stored modules
LITE VAE grid: 10 × 18 for 320 × 576 (32× spatial stride)
PRO uses a DIFFERENT DiT checkpoint and Wan VAE (8× spatial stride)
Neither an LTX 2.3 generator nor a text-prompted LTX workflow runs here
